targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  d.metric_date,
  p.name AS project_name,
  u.username,
  u.name AS full_name,
  d.commits_count,
  d.merge_requests_opened,
  d.merge_requests_merged,
  d.estimated_hours
FROM gitmetrics.daily_user_metrics d
JOIN gitmetrics.projects p ON d.project_id = p.id
JOIN gitmetrics.users u ON d.user_id = u.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.metric_date)
ORDER BY d.metric_date DESC, project_name, username;

SELECT 
  d.metric_date AS time,
  u.username AS metric,
  d.commits_count AS value
FROM gitmetrics.daily_user_metrics d
JOIN gitmetrics.users u ON d.user_id = u.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.metric_date);

SELECT 
  u.username,
  SUM(d.estimated_hours) AS hours
FROM gitmetrics.daily_user_metrics d
JOIN gitmetrics.users u ON d.user_id = u.id
WHERE d.metric_date = CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY u.username
ORDER BY hours DESC;
